items.title: AI Fluency Crash Course
items.description: First-of-its-kind session at Ichalkaranji, designed to help students go beyond basic AI use — covering effective learning techniques, AI applications in Accounting, Finance & Marketing, prompting and research skills, CV and interview preparation, and responsible AI use. Includes a live quiz with prizes and a completion certificate for all participants.
